name: Kosmos-57
about: Kosmos-57 (1965-012A), a crewed vehicle (Voskhod), launched 1965 Feb 22. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (E).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1965 Feb 22), held fixed
broke up in orbit (GCAT status E)
